coa.title: How to read a Certificate of Analysis
coa.description: What each line of a peptide Certificate of Analysis means, what to check against the vial, and what a certificate cannot tell you.
coa.lead: A Certificate of Analysis is the document that separates a verified lot from a claim. This is what each line means, and what to check it against.
coa.s1_t: The compound and the lot code
coa.s1_b: The certificate names one compound and one lot. The lot code on the certificate must match the code on the vial label. A certificate without a lot code describes nothing in particular.
coa.s2_b: High-performance liquid chromatography separates the sample and reports how much of it is the named compound. Mass spectrometry confirms that the compound is the one named, by its mass. A certificate that carries one without the other has confirmed purity without identity, or identity without purity.
coa.s3_b: Purity is the share of the sample that is the named compound, by chromatographic area. AXIOM holds a threshold of {threshold} and does not list a lot below it. A figure is only as good as the method and the date beside it.
coa.s4_b: The observed mass should sit close to the expected mass of the molecule. A large gap means the sample is not what the label says. AXIOM prints only a mass that was measured, never one copied from a reference.
coa.s5_b: A certificate is issued on a date, for a lot received on a date. An old certificate re-used for a new lot is the most common form of a false document.
coa.s6_t: What a certificate cannot tell you
coa.s6_b: It says nothing about what a compound does, how it is used or whether it is lawful to hold in your territory. It documents a lot. Everything else is a separate question.
coa.cta: See the sample certificate on the standard page

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms under which AXIOM supplies research compounds, therapy devices and apparel to accounts in Indonesia.
terms.lead: Short, and read in full. These terms govern every quote, order and invoice AXIOM issues.
terms.b1: AXIOM supplies from one catalogue at one price per lot, the same for every account. A quote is an offer priced from that catalogue; the price on a sent quote is frozen for its validity period and does not change on the order or the invoice.
terms.b2: Peptides are supplied exclusively for in-vitro laboratory and scientific research. They are not drugs, food, cosmetics or supplements and are not for human or veterinary consumption, diagnosis or treatment. AXIOM provides no dosing, administration or usage guidance and the buyer agrees not to seek it from AXIOM.
terms.b3: Peptide commerce requires a recorded acknowledgement that the buyer is eighteen or older and a qualified researcher or institutional buyer. The acknowledgement is versioned and timestamped, is valid for twelve months, and lapses on its anniversary unless renewed. No peptide price, quote or order is issued to an account without a current acknowledgement.
terms.b4: Several compounds are controlled or regulated in some territories. The buyer is solely responsible for the legality of import, possession, handling and use in its territory. AXIOM makes no representation of legality anywhere.
terms.b5: A quote is valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from the day it is sent. Accepting it creates the order and its invoice together. Payment is by bank transfer in Indonesian rupiah, in full, before dispatch. The invoice is an Indonesian tax document issued by the entity named on it.
terms.b6: Delivery is charged per consignment, {per} per three units per destination, capped at {cap} per destination, and is shown in the basket before the request is submitted. Peptide lots are dispatched temperature-managed with their Certificate of Analysis. Risk passes on delivery to the named destination.
terms.b7: Availability is the only stock figure AXIOM publishes. A lot with none available may be requested but is not priced into a sendable quote until it is back.
terms.b8: An order may be cancelled before dispatch and the cancellation is recorded. Cold-chain lots that have left AXIOM cannot be returned, because their storage history can no longer be verified. Devices and apparel may be returned unused within a stated window on the invoice.
terms.b9: AXIOM's liability for any lot is limited to its replacement or the refund of its price. AXIOM is not liable for any use of a research compound outside in-vitro laboratory research.
terms.b10: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Indonesia. They are issued in Indonesian and English; where the two differ, the Indonesian text prevails.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How AXIOM handles personal data under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP), including the acknowledgement record and its retention.
privacy.lead: AXIOM processes personal data under Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP). This notice states what is collected, why, for how long, and the rights that attach to it.
privacy.b1: The controller is the AXIOM entity named on the invoice, Jakarta, Indonesia. Requests concerning personal data are answered through the WhatsApp line on the contact page.
privacy.b2: Name, clinic or institution, role, email address and WhatsApp number, given on the request form or at sign-in; the contents of quotes, orders and invoices; the delivery addresses of an account's sites; and the acknowledgement record described below.
privacy.h3: 3. The acknowledgement record is personal data
privacy.b3: The acknowledgement that a buyer is eighteen or older and a qualified researcher is recorded with the person's identity, the version of the text acknowledged, the time, and the network address and browser from which it was given. It is personal data under UU PDP and is processed on the basis of performing the contract of supply and of AXIOM's legal obligations.
privacy.b4: The acknowledgement record is retained for the twelve months of its validity and for five years after it lapses, because it evidences the basis on which research compounds were supplied. Quotes, orders and invoices are retained for the period Indonesian tax law requires. A lead that does not become an account is deleted after twelve months of inactivity.
privacy.b5: Personal data is shared with the carrier for delivery, with the bank for payment reconciliation and with the tax authority as an invoice requires. It is not sold and not shared for advertising.
privacy.b6: Under UU PDP a person may ask what personal data AXIOM holds about them, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, withdraw consent where processing rests on consent, and object to processing. A request is answered within the period the law sets. Deletion does not extend to records AXIOM is required to keep.
privacy.b7: The site sets a cookie for the language, one for the basket and one for the session. It does not set advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.b8: This notice is revised when the processing changes. The date of the current revision is shown below.
